findings.note: Two rounds on the same head (dad90d8) fail for one structural reason: the pre-existing SEO title-keyword gate counts the five proof cards' verbatim third-party PR h3 titles in its denominator (EN 8/20, ZH 9/20, and even an H2-only scope gives EN 5/12 under the required 6), while the ticket simultaneously demands those exact titles, exact PR links, a 60-day public-repo window and the untouched no-human-review mark, so the only way to pass both is cherry-picking merges by 'ai'/'pr' substrings under HOME_MAX_PER_REPO=2 rather than taking the genuinely most recent five.
findings.fix: The person must choose which requirement yields — scope the gate to first-party headings, or let the cards carry first-party headlines instead of verbatim PR titles — then amend the ticket body and requeue.

question.summary: The SEO gate and this ticket are mutually exclusive: the five verbatim third-party PR titles the ticket requires are counted as page titles that must contain search terms, so no selection of the most recent public merges can pass both as written.
question.question: Which requirement should give way so the proof list and the SEO gate can both be satisfied honestly?

options.label: Scope the SEO gate
options.description: The homepage title-keyword gate measures only first-party h1/h2/h3 headings outside .proof-card-title, and the five proof cards show the five most recent external merges from the last 60 days in still-public repositories, each linking to its PR, with no private repository listed, the no-human-review mark kept, Tommy Xiao's quote linked to the original tweet, and EN and ZH pages identical.
options.reason: Keeps the ticket's verbatim-title intent and only changes what a gate measures, which the evidence shows is the smaller, safer change.

options.label: First-party card headlines
options.description: Each proof card shows a first-party headline containing the page's target search term plus the repository name and a link to its PR, instead of the verbatim third-party PR title, while the five most recent external merges from the last 60 days in still-public repositories, the no-human-review mark, Tommy Xiao's tweet link, and identical EN/ZH lists are all preserved.
options.reason: Keeps the existing gate untouched but drops the verbatim PR title the ticket currently specifies.
